violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed glove changes by employee and he did not wash his hands before putting on new gloves. Hands should be washed before putting on new gloves.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Inside of the cooler in the drive up area was found dirty. The shelving units in the walk-in cooler were found dirty. These items should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Lids for storage containers were found stored in dirty totes during inspection. Clean equipment should be stored in a clean location.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Portion cups and lids near handwashing sink and cup lids next to dining room soda dispenser were found in dirty containers. Single use items should be stored in a clean location.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Hot water was found at 148F at the handwashing sink in the kitchen. Hot water should not exceed 120F.

General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Food employee entered work area to help customer from dining area and did not wash his hands before putting on gloves. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Walk-in cooler shelving unit was found dirty during inspection. Shelving unit should be cleaned and maintained clean.
